overview.title: Your AI. Your machine.
overview.subtitle: Chat with local models, keep your data on your device, and choose the setup that fits your hardware.
overview.modelDetail: Your model stays on this device
overview.workspacesDescription: Start with chat today. More local AI workflows will appear here as they become ready.
overview.workspaceNote: Only available workspaces are interactive. Planned areas are not presented as working features.
workspace.chatDescription: Ask questions and work with text
chat.title: Chat with your model
chat.notReady: Install and start a chat model to begin.
chat.welcomeTitle: What would you like to work on?
chat.welcomeDescription: Your prompt is sent to the model running on this computer. Nothing is uploaded by Local AI Runtime.
chat.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
models.title: Find your next model
models.description: Browse reviewed models and the runtimes that power them. Model files and engine packages are installed separately and remain in your local user-data folder.
models.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, family, task or license…
activity.enginesDescription: A running process becomes ready only after its local model server passes a health check.
activity.jobsDescription: Track downloads, installation, engine start/stop and local inference in one persistent history. Diagnostics are created locally and are never uploaded automatically.
activity.includeLogs: Include engine process logs (may contain prompts or local paths).
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used for Local AI Runtime controls and guidance.
settings.updateDescription: Release checks use the official GitHub release feed. Downloads require your confirmation.
settings.manualSetupDescription: Only needed if you already have a llama-server executable and a GGUF model.
settings.manualSetupPrivacy: This writes a local engine configuration. No model file is uploaded.
settings.backendHint: GPU placement is not guaranteed. Verify it with a real local request.
settings.privacyDescription: Models, configuration and logs stay in your local user-data folder. Local AI Runtime does not upload prompts, responses or hardware inventory.
device.title: Device & model fit
device.privacy: Hardware details are detected on this computer only. Detection is a starting point, not a compatibility guarantee.
device.measureGpu: Measure GPU during a local test
device.gpuHint: Start a CUDA-enabled chat engine before measuring GPU activity during a real local request.
chat.historyPrivacy: Conversations are stored only in this browser on this device.
chat.localStorageNote: Chat history stays on this device. It is not included in diagnostics.
chat.invalidStream: The model returned an invalid streaming response.
chat.streamingUnsupported: Streaming is not available in this desktop web runtime.
chat.emptyResponse: The model returned an empty response.
chat.stoppedBeforeResponse: Generation stopped before a response arrived.
chat.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user directly and concisely in the same language as the user. Do not claim you cannot answer ordinary greetings or requests. Do not provide code unless the user asks for code.
chat.promptExplain: Explain a complex idea in simple terms.
chat.promptPlan: Help me plan a small project step by step.
chat.promptWrite: Review this text and suggest improvements.
chat.streamIncomplete: The model stream ended before completion. Any partial response has been kept.
activity.resourcesDescription: Live CPU and memory readings are local. Engine usage is process-level; NVIDIA GPU readings are system-wide and may include other apps.
activity.resourcesGpuUnavailable: Live GPU telemetry is unavailable on this device.
activity.resourcesGpuScope: GPU readings are system-wide and do not prove that a particular engine uses the GPU.
